children: may test a resistance at $4,440 per ounce, a break above which could open the way toward $4,489.

The metal managed to partially reverse its fall after stabilizing around a support at $4,342. It has climbed above a falling wedge as well. These bullish moves indicate an extension of the uptrend from $4,281.

The trend could be riding on a wave c, which may travel above the above the peak of the wave a at $4,511. This assumed wave mode will become invalid once the market breaks $4,379, as such a break may trigger a fall into the $4,281-$4,342 range.
On the daily chart, the bounce on Sept. 2 and Sept. 3 defines a neutral zone of $4,306-$4,529. Trending signals will become clearer when the metal gets out of it.
Until the bounce extends above $4,529, the downtrend is likely to resume.
